Millions of students, faculty and administrators from over 60,000 K-12 schools and higher education institutions worldwide use Schoology to advance what is possible in education. We are looking for a strong candidate to help deliver that vision. Working at Schoology offers you a chance to help solve the most important challenges in education at scale in an environment that's fun, collaborative, and innovative. We are looking for smart, creative individuals who are passionate about education and are not afraid to show it.

Our Research & Development (R&D) team is the technical talent at the heart of our product suite, overseeing the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery. From engineering to quality assurance to data science, the R&D team ensures our customers seamlessly use our products and can depend on their consistency.

The Schoology Software Engineering team is a group of full stack developers who design, develop, and maintain our products, tools, and infrastructure.

-  Developing and operating microservices in a multi-tenant, distributed environment

-  Deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting services on AWS, using Docker and Kubernetes 
-  Collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions

- Minimum of 2–5 years of relevant and related work experience.
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, or equivalent years of relevant work experience.



Preferred Qualifications



- 2–5 years of relevant software engineering experience.
- Strong backend development experience with PHP, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Node.js.
- Experience building microservices and APIs in multi-tenant environments, with a understanding of distributed systems, software design principles and patterns.
- Experience with MySQL/Aurora, MongoDB, and Redis.
- Good to have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS services, and CI/CD pipelines, including build and deployment processes.
- Experience building prototypes and proof-of-concepts (PoCs).
- Hands-on experience with AI agents and AI-powered development tools such as Cursor and GitHub Copilot.



Soft Skills



- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills

medium.title: Staff IT Software Engineer
medium.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Staff Full Stack Engineer, you will be a technical leader and a key driver behind our product’s architecture, user experience, and intelligent capabilities.

This role demands a unique combination of enterprise-grade backend stability, modern frontend design, and the ability to

integrate cutting-edge AI technologies natively built on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

You will partner closely with Product, UX Design, Architecture, and Data Science teams to translate high-level business goals into robust full-stack applications. You will be instrumental in building autonomous AI agentic solutions that proactively plan and execute multi-step tasks,

leveraging our enterprise AI platforms to deliver low-latency, scalable, and ethical implementations. While you will remain deeply hands-on, your success will also be measured by your ability to elevate the engineers around you, champion design standards, and turn complex

AI paradigms into seamless user experiences.



- Design, build, and scale highly available, secure backend microservices alongside modern, performance-optimized, and responsive frontends.
- Design, orchestrate, and deploy production-ready agentic workflows that leverage LLM
- reasoning, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for independent decision-making and complex task execution.
- Develop core full-stack components that interface with Generative AI model deployment and real-time inference systems. Optimize large-scale AI interactions for performance, low latency, and high throughput.
- Establish long-term architectural patterns and tooling choices for our Java, Next.js, and Google Cloud ecosystem, preferably GCP Vertex AI or equivalent.
- Champion design standards, rigorous type safety, automated testing, and comprehensive monitoring across decoupled repositories, UI components, and AI inference pipelines.
- Ensure all full-stack applications and integrated AI systems comply with enterprise security policies, data privacy standards, and responsible AI principles.
- Lead deep technical design reviews, perform high-impact code reviews, mentor engineers, and foster a culture of engineering excellence and continuous learning.

Qualifications



- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of operating at a Staff, or Tech Lead level.
- 2+ years of hands-on experience designing, fine-tuning, and building autonomous AIagentic solutions, LLM architectures, and RAG pipelines in a production setting.
- Expert-level experience with Java and Spring Boot (or equivalent enterprise frameworks like Go or advanced Node.js) building resilient distributed systems and secure RESTful APIs. Experience with SQL (MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Cassandra) schema design and performance tuning.
- Deep experience building complex, production-grade web applications using React, TypeScript, Next.js, and Node.js. Strong understanding of SSR (Server-Side Rendering).
- State management, and building intuitive, responsive interfaces for data-dense AI workflows.
- Strong experience designing and deploying distributed systems on Google Cloud Platform, specifically using Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or Cloud Run, alongside modern CI/CD tools (Harness, Jenkins).
- A strong focus on the end-user. You understand how to handle the unique UI/UX challenges of Generative AI, such as streaming model responses, conversational state management, and elegant fallback UI states.
- Exceptional ability to articulate complex technical, cloud, and AI concepts to both deeply technical engineers and non-technical business stakeholders.

Preferred / Bonus Points



- Proficiency in Python for backend development, quick AI prototyping, and data
- processing.
- Experience with open-source AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex).
- Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect or Professional Data Engineer.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity principles for AI applications.

Our Commitment 

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

Job Requirements

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology 

Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally.

The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world.

Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: 



-  Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come.

2. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.



-  Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems.

Ad Platforms is responsible for Disney’s industry-leading ad technology and products – driving advertising performance, innovation, and value in Disney’s sports, news, and entertainment content, across all media platforms.

Job Summary

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer II to help design, build, and maintain the web applications and services behind Disney's Ad Technology platform. You'll work across the stack – from React-based front ends to Node.js/TypeScript and Go-based services – while also getting hands-on with the CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure that deploy and run them, alongside senior engineers. This role is a great opportunity to grow both full-stack and DevOps skills while contributing to the tools and platforms that support Disney's advertising applications.

Responsibilities



-  Frontend Development: Build and maintain responsive, accessible user interfaces using React, contributing reusable components and improving front-end performance.
-  Backend Services: Design, develop, and maintain APIs and microservices using Node.js, TypeScript, and Go, following established patterns and best practices.
-  Data & Scripting: Write Python scripts and services for automation, data processing, and internal tooling in support of the broader engineering team.
-  Code Quality & Testing: Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests; participate in code reviews to maintain high standards of code quality and maintainability.
-  Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with product managers, designers, and senior engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions across the stack.
-  Documentation: Maintain technical documentation, including API specs, architecture notes, and onboarding guides.
-  DevOps & Deployment: Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows, and contribute to infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS) under guidance from senior engineers.

Basic Qualifications



-  2+ years of professional software engineering experience building full-stack web applications.
-  Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, with hands-on experience building services with Node.js.
-  Working experience with React for building modern user interfaces.
-  Exposure to GoLang for building performant backend services.
-  Experience writing Python for scripting, automation, or backend development.
-  Familiarity with RESTful API design, version control (Git), and CI/CD workflows.
-  Basic exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS) and containerization (Docker), with willingness to grow into deployment and infrastructure ownership.
-  Strong desire to learn, ask questions, and grow as a full-stack engineer.

Preferred Qualifications



-  Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and containerized environments such as Kubernetes/EKS.
-  Exposure to GraphQL, gRPC, or event-driven architectures.
-  Awareness of security fundamentals such as authentication, authorization, and secure coding practices.
-  Experience with observability tooling (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus) for monitoring full-stack applications.
-  Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and CI/CD pipeline tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker).
-  Exposure to on-call rotations or incident response for production systems.

Required Education



-  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field (or equivalent experience)

Disclaimer 

This position is with Disney (India) Private Limited, which is part of a business we call Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology.

It gives developers a fast, reliable Postgres that works natively alongside ClickHouse, so one platform covers both transactional and real-time analytical workloads. This is a strategic, high-visibility initiative, and the user experience we build will shape how thousands of developers create, manage, monitor, and scale their databases.
